hero.label: The Art of Wellness
hero.title: A place for creativity in healthcare.
hero.lead: A NORTH Foundation program at Royal North Shore Hospital in Sydney, bringing comfort, connection and healing to patients, carers and staff through art and music.
hero.imageAlt: Artworks from a session: a sunflower, a tree and the word Hope, with coloured pencils

why.label: Why it matters
why.title: Moments of calm, expression and joy.
why.lead: A hospital can be a confronting place. For patients and families facing illness, treatment or long stays, the arts offer a welcome pause.
why.text: Music can lift spirits. Making art can create connection and a meaningful outlet during difficult times.
why.quote: “To bring support to patients, carers and staff through the inclusion of the arts.”
why.cite: The Art of Wellness mission, NORTH Foundation

parts.label: Inside the program
parts.title: Three ways the arts show up.

participatoryArt.title: Participatory art
participatoryArt.text: Led by volunteers, including a trained art therapist, these sessions invite patients, carers and staff to pause, create and express themselves.
participatoryArt.alt: A large, colourful group drawing of flowers made during an Art of Wellness session

festivalOfMusic.title: Festival of Music
festivalOfMusic.text: Since 2016, five days of live music each December, from staff, schools, choirs and community performers in the hospital’s main atrium.
festivalOfMusic.alt: A staff choir in Santa hats performing in the hospital atrium

staffPhotography.title: Staff photography
staffPhotography.text: An annual competition. In 2025, 25 photographs were chosen from 76 entries, framed and hung in Ambulatory Care.
staffPhotography.alt: A framed staff photograph of a red waratah and a bird, hanging in the hospital

team.label: The team
team.title: Meet The Art of Wellness team.

susanDay.bio: Has led the RNSH Festival of Music since 2016, after 30 years in stroke services. Awarded an OAM in 2022 for service to the community.

mimiEieyeh.role: Mental Health Nurse (CNS) / Art Therapist · Co-founder
mimiEieyeh.bio: Known to VetMiMi visitors as Daw Mi. A mental health nurse for 17 years and an art therapist since 2023.

michelleFawcett.bio: Supports the volunteers at Royal North Shore and Ryde Hospitals, and sits on the RNSH Arts and Culture Committee.

support.label: Support the program
support.title: Help bring the arts into more wards.
support.lead: The Art of Wellness is funded by donations through NORTH Foundation. Your support helps the program reach patients in hospital wards who cannot come to it.
